title: SignalMeta
description: What an agent's signal metadata says about how a finding or stand-aside was made. Each field is present only when the agent sent it.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens of the agent's model calls for the signal.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens of the agent's model calls for the signal.

toolsUsed.description: The tools the agent has enabled, sent with agree.

failureType.description: The kind of failure, on a failure.
